title: Alo Yoga Product Knowledge Certification Exam
description: This comprehensive exam tests your knowledge of Alo Yoga fabrics, product lines, and selling strategies.
instructions: Answer all questions. Multiple choice and True/False are graded instantly. Short answers are keyword-graded instantly and show a model answer for review.

questions.q: What does the acronym 'Alo' stand for?
Which fabric offers the highest compression and a sculpting fit with a subtle sheen?
questions.explanation: Airlift is the highest-compression sculpting fabric.

questions.q: Which fabric is designed with a soft-matte finish and creates a 'blurring' effect to smooth skin appearance?
questions.explanation: Airbrush has the soft-matte blurring effect.

questions.q: Which Alo Yoga men's line is specifically designed for high-intensity HIIT and cardio workouts?
Which fabric blend is best recommended for a customer seeking a balance of comfort and stretch?
questions.explanation: Cotton + Elastane balances comfort and stretch.

questions.q: What is the primary benefit of the 'Recovery Sneaker'?
options: High-rebound support for pressure points in feet, knees, and back
Extra height with a thick platform
questions.explanation: Recovery Sneaker = high-rebound support for pressure points.

questions.q: Which product line is known for being 'unisex' and features a soft cotton fleece feel?
For a 'Luxury Buyer' who values finishing and texture, which fabric should you recommend?
What is a key characteristic of the 'Scholar' line for men?
Which fabric is best for a customer looking for 'buttery-soft' comfort for lounging or low-impact flow?
Cashmere is a synthetic fiber derived from petroleum.
questions.explanation: False — cashmere is a natural luxury fiber.

questions.q: The 'Chill' line is designed primarily for high-intensity training sessions.
questions.explanation: False — Chill is for lounge / travel.

questions.q: Airlift fabric provides the strongest hold among all Alo legging fabrics.
The 'Double Take' line offers a polished, 'smart casual' aesthetic for men.
You should advise customers with fabric sensitivity to wash synthetic garments before their first wear.
The 'Vapor' line is designed for maximum warmth in freezing temperatures.
Alo Yoga was founded in Los Angeles in 2007.
The 'Waffle' line features a textured knit fabric that provides light warmth and breathability.
Explain the difference in recommended usage between the 'Conquer' and 'Chill' lines.
questions.modelAnswer: Conquer is for high-performance training; Chill is for lounge/travel.
questions.explanation: Mention Conquer = high-performance training AND Chill = lounge/travel.

questions.q: List three 'Core Colors' available at Alo Yoga.
questions.modelAnswer: Black, White, Espresso (or Gravel, Gray, Anthracite).
questions.explanation: Any three core colors: e.g. Black, White, Espresso / Gravel / Gray / Anthracite.

questions.q: Why is it important to ask customers about their intended activity level when selling Alo apparel?
questions.modelAnswer: To match the fabric performance (compression vs comfort) to their specific needs.
questions.explanation: So you can match compression vs comfort to their needs.

questions.q: What are the key benefits of mixing Elastane into fabric blends like Cotton or Polyester?
questions.modelAnswer: Adds stretch, flexibility, and helps the garment retain its shape.
